answer: Each identity joins an island cohort and locks a 70-credit bond. Each epoch it files a walnut harvest from its plot: count plus a ferrous seal serial from the epoch seed. Peers cross-check the ledger; a reused ferrous serial or plot burns both bonds. First fake 34, k-th 34+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,031,000 plus 70,000 locked; a rented-grove ring fails because its seal serial was already filed. An honest agent pays 34 once and reclaims its bond.
